1.title: Hello from Python

testCases.description: Output must be exactly: Hello, World!
No syntax errors in your code

2.title: Sum of Two Numbers
2.description: Write a Python function called add(a, b) that returns the sum of two numbers. Call it with add(5, 3) and print the result.

testCases.description: Define a function named add(a, b)
The function must return a + b

3.title: Even or Odd
3.description: Write a Python function is_even(num) that returns True if num is even and False if odd. Test with 4 and 7.
3.expectedOutputHint:
Your output should be:
True
False

4.title: Reverse a String
4.description: Write a Python function reverse_string(s) that reverses a string. Call it with 'hello' and print the result.
4.expectedOutputHint: Your output should be exactly: olleh

5.title: Find Maximum in a List
5.description: Write a Python function find_max(lst) that returns the largest number in a list. Test with [3, 7, 2, 9, 1].

testCases.description: Must return the largest number without using max()

6.title: Lesson Count Label: convert a number to text
6.description: Implement `lesson_label(count)` to return the text `Lessons: ` followed by the supplied count. Use str so integer counts can be joined to a string.
6.learningObjective: Convert an integer to a string before joining it with a text label.
